Replacement Inside Parenthesis

Source: R/intern_.in_parenthesis_replacement.R
dot-in_parenthesis_replacement.Rd

Replace each match of a pattern located between two given brackets of a string by a replacement character, and return the positions of the replacements.

Usage

.in_parenthesis_replacement(
  string,
  pattern,
  no_regex_pattern,
  replacement,
  perl,
  open_pos,
  close_pos,
  lib_path,
  error_text
)

Arguments

string

Single string.

pattern

Single string: regex matching a single character, like ",".

no_regex_pattern

Single string: the character matched by pattern, without regex escape. Used to check the replaced characters.

replacement

Single character replacing each match of pattern. Not a regex.

perl

Single logical value. Use Perl regex in pattern?

open_pos

Single integer: position of an opening bracket ( in string.

close_pos

Single integer: position of a closing bracket ) in string.

lib_path

Vector of character strings or NULL: the lib_path value of the calling exported function, only passed on to arg_check(). No default value.

error_text

Single character string added to the error messages to name the calling functions (embed_error_text of the calling function). NULL is converted into "". No default value.

Value

A list containing:

  • string: string with the matches of pattern between the positions open_pos and close_pos replaced by replacement.

  • pos: vector of the positions of the replaced matches in string. NULL if no match. In that case, string is identical to the input string.

Details

Warnings:

  • pattern must match a single character.

  • requires saferDev::arg_check.

  • In the safer Backbone section "######## check of the required functions from the required packages", add also saferDev::arg_check when checking for the presence of .in_parenthesis_replacement.
